title: The whole night, start to finish
notes:
THE DECKS

- Every deck on one screen: title, artist, art, BPM, pitch, time left, ON AIR, MASTER and a scrolling waveform with the beat grid. It fits the small window beside the lighting desk, a phone and a laptop.
- A deck says why when something is missing (waiting for the player, a streaming track, a file not analysed in rekordbox) and gets it again by itself.
- SAME TRACK TONIGHT: a loaded track that already went out tonight says PLAYED 23:14 in amber, and when it played here before.
- MIX HINT: whether the next track's key fits what's on air, and the tempo change it needs.

THE NIGHT

- NIGHTS: plan a night with its start, MUSIC OFF and the lineup. ON THE DECKS follows it by itself. When the HARD STOP app sends the lineup and cutoff, those win.
- SET TIME: in the last 10 minutes one calm line says whether the track on air ends before MUSIC OFF. RUNNING LATE moves the rest of the night once.
- STAGE CLOCK and NEXT UP: a big clock for the DJ's screen, and who's on next for the crowd.
- NIGHT SAFETY: SHOW STOP puts STOP THE MUSIC or your words on every screen; HOLD; the CURFEW LADDER (off until you turn it on); DOOR COUNT.
- WEATHER for outdoor nights, MOMENTS (speeches, a first dance) and SET NOTES.
- READY FOR TONIGHT: one verdict before doors, or the one thing to fix.

AFTER THE NIGHT

- PLAYED keeps every track, grouped by DJ, with the night's numbers. COPY gives the setlist, a tracklist for Mixcloud or a playlist.
- END OF NIGHT, the NIGHT REPORT, SET INSIGHTS (the night's journey and every change-over in plain words), ROYALTY SETLISTS and the NIGHT LOG.
- GHOST WRAPPED and MILESTONES: your nights as cards, and little moments from the box's own history.
- SET RECORDINGS: one lossless file per set with a timed tracklist, only when someone taps RECORD.

THE ROOM

- LIGHTS: plain RGB lights and LED strips follow the music by themselves. SHOW CONTROL sends the tempo to Ableton Link, MIDI clock, Resolume, grandMA3, QLab and more. VISUALS LINK picks clips by track.
- TV MODE, the STREAM OVERLAY with HIDE IDS, SONG ID FOR THE CROWD and ASK THE DJ (song requests and votes from the crowd's phones; no money).
- CREW CALLS with a countdown on every screen, ANNOUNCEMENTS and the SOUNDBOARD through a USB sound card.

WITH HARD STOP (ONLY WHEN YOU HAVE IT)

- The HARD STOP HUB: panels and the app join a crew room on the box over the venue Wi-Fi. BOOTH ASKS reach the booth's screens too.

THE BOX

- SET UP THIS BOX: a new box walks you from its own Wi-Fi to your first night in about 3 minutes. It ends with one optional card, KEEP IT IN YOUR ACCOUNT? Say NOT NOW and it never asks again.
- YOUR ACCOUNT (optional): the box can sit in your account, the same one for GHOST LINK and HARD STOP. It then shows its version and when it was last seen there, and you can get one email when an update is out (EMAILS ME ABOUT UPDATES). Everything works the same without one.
- HAND OVER: selling it, giving it away or starting over. It gets a new key, forgets its phones, Wi-Fi, HARD STOP link and nights, and goes back to first-time setup. KEEP MY MUSIC keeps whose USB stick is whose.
- UPDATES: one card, never mid-set. Updates wait for a quiet moment after the night.
- SHARE LINKS, API KEYS for the crew's tools, WATCH FROM HOME, STAND BY, BACKUP and the BLACK BOX.
- Faster pages, a lighter box, and every error in plain words.
how: The box updates itself in a quiet moment after the night (or tap UPDATE TONIGHT AFTER MUSIC OFF in STATUS -> UPDATES). Never mid-set.
